# 5. Interaction Flow Following the layered architecture defined in the previous chapter, the following picture demonstrates the interaction flow that provides an abstract overview of how a task is executed end-to-end. In network operator layer, optimization agent is capable of the L4 cognitive abilities, and NOE copilot could support efficient instruction for on-site implementation scenarios (e.g., capacity expansion). In service layer, the intent manager is responsible for generating the intent for quality optimization and/or capacity planning. The network planning system get the capacity expansion intent which is generated by the optimization agent and verified by the intent manager. The internal workflow of network planning system is out of the scope of this document. [Figure: Interaction flow that provides an abstract overview of how a task is executed end-to-end across network operator layer, service layer, and network planning system.] 1. Step1: The intent for IP network quality optimization is input from the quality optimization agent of service layer to the optimization agent in network layer. 2. Step2: Utilizing the network data get from NEs, the optimization agent automatically identifies the quality degradation. 3. Step 3: Based on automatic demarcation and root cause analysis of the quality degradation issue, the optimization agent intelligent generate and execute the optimization solution for path adjustment. If the network resource is not sufficient for optimization based on path adjustment, the agent provides the capacity expansion solution with simulation results that illustrates the rationality of expansion. 4. Step 4: The results of Steps 3 could be automatically reported to the intent manger to help verify the fulfillment of the intent. 5. Step5: If the capacity expansion is essential, the intent manager further input the expansion intent to the network planning system. 6. Step 6: When implementing capacity expansion, the on-site O&M engineer could query the required information through NOE copilot. 7. Step7: The service layer NOE copilot dispatches the IP related queries and tasks to the NOE copilot at network layer.
